offering_description.value: Sells cloud telephone and unified communications services, plus web hosting and website services, to small and mid-sized businesses. Delivered through a hosted cloud platform, sold directly and through partners.

primary_products.value: cloud phone systems; IP desk phones; contact center software

primary_services.value: unified communications as a service; web hosting; website design and digital marketing; business internet connectivity

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized businesses, call centers and multi-site organizations

end_markets.value: small business services; call centers; professional services; retail

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly fees for cloud phone and unified communications service; product sales: IP phones and other telephone hardware; service fees: website design, hosting and digital marketing services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: hosted cloud telephony platform used by business customers; service provider: web hosting and marketing services sold to small businesses; distributor: resells phone hardware made by others to its customers

geography_served.value: US national: customers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: cloud telephony, unified communications, and web hosting and marketing services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales team selling to small businesses; online: web-based sign-up for hosted services; partners / resellers: channel partners that resell its cloud telephone services

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: telecom service rules from the FCC and state regulators, such as E911 and consumer protection rules

notes: Segment mix and recent divestitures are uncertain, so the business description may not match the current structure exactly.
